verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1691). Measures the consequence in the code the settle runs: sendOrderReceipts routes ownerKind split to sendSplitOrderReceipts before the single-seller buyer send; that half reads the ledger through listOrderTransfers (itself checked to read commerce_order_transfers), sends notifyEarner once per transfer row priced from that row (gross = amount + fee, net = amount), puts the buyer lines under each seller name, never names Frequency as the seller, carries no em dash; checkout plans the transfer rows before it calls the receipts; and the receipt and wiring tests still pin the two-seller receipt, the per-seller share, the replay, and the byte-identical single-seller messages. Fails on main (7cba7d186) at the first arm. Static, under 0.05 s.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1691). PREMISE HELD at 7cba7d186 (main): sendOrderReceipts ran the single-seller half for a split order; resolveSeller returned null for owner_kind split, so the buyer receipt said "Your order from Frequency" and "Frequency can see the order now and will send it on", and the seller half logged "no seller to notify for a paid order" and returned. WHAT CHANGED. lib/commerce/order-receipt.ts routes a split order to sendSplitOrderReceipts: the buyer receipt lists the order lines grouped under each seller's name with their price, then the total, and says each seller sends their own part; every seller with a commerce_order_transfers row (listOrderTransfers) gets one notifyEarner (bell plus email) for their share only: their lines, Your sale (gross), Network fee (dropped at 0), You receive (the transfer amount). Same settle flip, so a replay sends nothing. Single-seller orders are unchanged and pinned against main's rendered text. Unreadable ledger or no rows: the buyer is still receipted and the miss is logged. Help (connecting/marketplace) and a CHANGELOG line. No migration.
